heading: Three ways to work together, in depth.
subtext: Each service is scoped to the project — here's how each one actually works, from first message to delivery.

services.name: Fashion & Luxury Content Strategy
services.summary: SEO-driven, brand-voice-accurate content planning for fashion and luxury e-commerce.
services.ideal_for: Brands who need a content plan, not just individual pieces — category pages, keyword strategy, editorial calendars.
process: Discovery call to understand your brand voice and goals
Content plan with priorities and timeline
services.pricing_note: Scoped per project after a discovery call — retainers available for ongoing work.

faq.question: How long does a typical engagement run?
faq.answer: Most content strategy projects run 4-8 weeks for the initial plan, with many clients continuing on a monthly retainer afterward.

faq.question: Do you write the content too, or just the strategy?
faq.answer: Both, if you want — strategy and writing are offered together or separately depending on your team's needs.

services.name: Fashion & Luxury Writing
services.summary: Product narrative, category copy, and editorial content for fashion and luxury brands.
services.ideal_for: Brands who have a content plan already and need polished, on-brand copy delivered against a brief.
process: First draft delivered against your timeline
Final delivery in your preferred format
services.pricing_note: Priced per piece or per word count band — ask for a quote against your specific brief.

faq.question: What's your typical turnaround?
faq.answer: 24-48 hours for shorter pieces (product copy, listicles); 1-2 weeks for long-form features, depending on research depth.

faq.question: Can you match an existing brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes — send existing brand guidelines or sample copy and I'll work within that voice, not just my own.

services.name: Personal Styling
services.summary: One-on-one styling support — wardrobe edits, capsule building, and personal aesthetic direction.
services.ideal_for: Individuals who want practical, personalized guidance rather than a generic style quiz.
process: Intake conversation about your current wardrobe, goals, and lifestyle
Wardrobe or shopping guidance tailored to you
services.pricing_note: Single sessions and ongoing packages both available — details shared after the intake conversation.

faq.question: Is this in-person or remote?
faq.answer: Remote — most sessions run over video call, with guidance and shopping links sent afterward.

faq.question: Do I need to buy new clothes for this to be useful?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — a lot of the value is in re-seeing what you already own. New pieces are recommended only where they genuinely help.
